meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 把项目的历史记录(保存在 claude-mem 里)按自然周拆开,并为每一周生成一章连续叙事,最终产出多章“周报式”故事文档。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成“每周摘要”“周更故事”“连续时间线”或某个项目的“叙事章节”时触发。

say.text: 按周讲讲这个项目的连续故事。

howto.what_en: Splits a project's claude-mem timeline into ISO-week files and produces one narrative chapter per week, chained by a carry-forward block so the story stays continuous.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for weekly digests, week-by-week stories, serial timelines, or narrative chapters of a project's history.

say_en.text: Generate weekly digests for this project, from start to finish.

say_en.text: Tell the project's story week by week.
